summary.tagline: Het Zwanenwater is een 604 hectare groot natuurgebied van de Vereniging Natuurmonumenten ten zuiden van Callan

days.title: Lakes and Observation Points
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: ersten Sees
stops.detail: Among other things, one has the opportunity to observe the animals of the first lake from two observation huts.

stops.name: Insel des zweiten Sees
stops.detail: A very special phenomenon is the spoonbill, which is only rarely encountered and feels at home here on the island of the second lake and breeds there.

stops.name: Heuwiesen

stops.name: Rundwanderwegen
